description:
Equifax es donde puedes impulsar tus posibilidades.  Si deseas alcanzar tu verdadero potencial, trazar nuevos caminos, desarrollar nuevas habilidades, colaborar con mentes brillantes y tener un impacto significativo, queremos saber de ti.
 
 Equifax is seeking creative, high-energy and driven software engineers with hands-on development skills to work on a variety of meaningful projects. Our software engineering positions provide you the opportunity to join a team of talented engineers working with leading-edge technology. You are ideal for this position if you are a forward-thinking, committed, and enthusiastic software engineer who is passionate about technology.
 
 What You'll Do 
 SAM Pro Implementation:   Design and configure the ServiceNow SAM Pro module, including entitlements, software models, and discovery patterns.

 Tier-1 Publisher Management:   Utilize and customize specialized Publisher Packs to manage complex licensing for:
 Microsoft:   Manage Office 365 SaaS consumption, SQL Server core-based licensing, and Windows Server infrastructure reports.

 Oracle:   Configure database cluster views, manage Oracle-specific reconciliation, and generate Effective License Position (ELP) reports.

 IBM:   Integrate with IBM License Metric Tool (ILMT) to track PVU-based licensing and ensure compliance for IBM software products.

 
 Shopping Cart & Procurement: 
 Integrate SAM with ServiceNow Shopping Hub and Service Catalog to automate software requests.

 Develop workflows that automate license reclamation and software deployment upon catalog approval.

 Configure Asset Management-Procurement Integration to automate entitlement creation from purchase orders.

 
 Optimization & Compliance:   Develop dashboards and automated "reclamation candidates" to identify underutilized software for cost savings.

 What Experience You Need 
 ServiceNow Expertise:   Proficiency in JavaScript (ServiceNow API), Business Rules, Script Includes, and Flow Designer.

 Integrations:   Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and Integration Hub to connect with external vendor portals and inventory tools.

 Data Management:   Skilled in using Transform Maps and Data Loads to ingest bulk entitlement data from legacy systems.

 Certifications:   ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS-SAM).

 What Could Set You Apart 
 SaaS Management:   Direct experience with SaaS License Management for cloud-based vendors.

 Frameworks:   Solid knowledge of ITIL v4 frameworks, particularly Service Request and Asset Management

 
 Ofrecemos modalidad de trabajo híbrido, horarios flexibles, días libres adicionales, paquetes integrales de compensación y seguro médico complementario, convenio con gimnasio, beneficios para madres y padres, acceso a nuestra plataforma de aprendizaje en línea, programas de reconocimiento, desarrollo de carrera profesional y un entorno diverso y multicultural, ¡entre otros!
 
 Equifax fue ranqueado en el top 5 de empresas con mejor desarrollo de carrera por LinkedIn.
 
 ¿Estás listo para impulsar tus posibilidades? ¡Aplica hoy y comienza un camino hacia una nueva y emocionante carrera en Equifax, donde puedes marcar la diferencia!

CHL-Santiago-Technology-Center
